prompt: Create a polished full-page DESKTOP marketing website design study for FAROS. Output one single tall page, 1440px wide by approximately 2900px tall (desktop page screenshot, NOT a narrow mobile layout). Use the attached six-direction design board as art-direction inspiration; reproduce neither its invented product claims nor its generic Violet Circuit name. Real product is faros, an operating system for AI-native platforms used by business users and AI agents. Retain Faros brand fonts: wide Archivo for headings, Instrument Sans for body, IBM Plex Mono only for small meaningful technical labels. All text readable and intentional. Top navigation faros / Platform / Developers / Docs / Request a demo. Primary action Request a demo; secondary Understand the platform. No cards or bento, no dashboard screenshots or fake application windows, no binary text or floating orbs. Each scene must flow into the next as one artwork. Use four spacious scenes, strong negative space, changes in scale, no grid or repetitive rows. FOCUS ON COLUMN THREE of attached board: INFINITE MACHINE. Light cool gray #f1f1f6 and deep graphite neutral large machine, violet #6b48e8 is one internal energy route. Monumental architecture-like machinery, cropped so just fragments visible in each scene; one enormous abstract computational artifact extends beyond every viewport, the same artifact seen at different scales throughout the page. Exact structural geometry, interconnected rails, channels, enormous circular apertures and sectional surfaces. Precision industrial design and scientific instruments, not spaceship HUD or literal robot. Hero headline placed upper left in large clear negative space, massive machine structure enters diagonally from far right and fills lower half with one violet channel. Next scene is an immense circular junction seen in architectural section, viewed closer, nearly full bleed, opening contains the 'A system of possibilities' copy with Applications / Agents / Infrastructure around three real ports. Next quieter scene is the machine's long straight channel with governance type alongside; final scene visually pulls back to reveal previous fragments are one connected system ending at demo CTA. Subtle material shading and dimensional depth, highly crafted, no gratuitous chrome, no busy doodle linework, no floating glass cards, no cyberpunk. Compared to other studies this must be truly monumental, material, and cinematic. Reference column three gives the ambition and zoom transitions, not a requirement for people, spacecraft, tiny labels, or stock sci-fi visuals. Strong depth from cast light on matte pale planes, internal violet illumination tightly confined to routes.
